title: Run your whole company from one place
description: Capture every conversation, clear the inbox, find customers, hire, and write in your voice. Everything you teach Strawberry stays with the company.
introduction: As a founder you're head of sales, head of recruiting, head of fundraising, and the person who fixes the printer. Usually all before lunch.
Strawberry can take a piece of each. And because every conversation you have can go into the team workspace, it gets better at all of them over time. The context stops living only in your head.

blocks.text: Not sure where to start? Your companion can look at the work you have open and suggest the first thing worth handing over.

skill.context: Ask your companion to look at your work and suggest the first thing to hand over.

blocks.text: One-on-ones, sales calls, candidate calls, investor and press conversations. Strawberry's transcription records them without a bot in the room, and each one adds to what your companions know about the company and how to talk about it.
A Routine labels your mail, archives the junk, and surfaces the few messages that need you, before you've opened your laptop.
Tell Strawberry who your best customers are and it finds more like them, with a reason and a source for each. Then it drafts outreach that sounds like you.

items.context: Find companies like your best customers, each with a reason it fits.

sections.title: Hire people like your best people

blocks.text: Describe someone great on your team. Strawberry turns what makes them great into a scorecard, shows you a few mock candidates to calibrate, then searches LinkedIn, GitHub, and the open web for real ones.

sections.title: Write posts in your own voice

blocks.text: The best material for your posts is what you've already said out loud. Strawberry drafts from your meetings and past writing, with generated images when they help.

items: Review contracts, decks, and specs, with questions and suggested edits.
Prepare a fundraise: investors who back similar companies, a target list, updates, and the deck.
Get a daily brief of meetings, open threads, and what changed.
Turn any research into a beautiful deck.

blocks.text: Everything you teach Strawberry stays with the company, not just with you. Save it to the team workspace and every teammate's companion knows how you sell, hire, and talk about the business.
When you hand over an area, hand over the companion too. The new person starts with months of context on day one.
